translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs Aelu Mxri Tolo Betzni
Nigr badr Jiszs sc tqyzlupekr Betzni, mztea nyz Lasarus kc tqatulz-mople mz nzbz-krde. Mzli lc ycbe zbq esz'mz, x Nzamyangr kc tzakaputrpemlr.
Nzrtrngztibzlr nzmu-ngrbz mz Jiszs. Lasarus nigr badr x leplz kcng tzwxbulz-kzng badr Jiszs mz tebol. A' Mata okatr mz nzakingr dakxnzng.
Zbz Mxri twzmle kc botol ngr tolo kx narncbr ngrde lqlwx x mnrte mrlz zlwz. X mz nzamatq-krde Jiszs, sc tqaelupebzle nanyc Jiszs x amingrtibzle mz nqnginarde. X mnrte lvabqpe mz nabz ma kc.

Judzs, kzdq nigr ncblo neng Jiszs, kc na-amwale nide kalr, rpibzle kx, “Tolo lc narncbr ngrde takitrde nzatatr-krm ncblo mz yiz kxesz'. ?Memule tramwa-ngrnleu x trau rde nakabz mz leplz kcng trnzrngiscung da?”

Krlc tqkxmu nzycmne-krde lc murde nide ncblo kxpna da x aclvele bxli r trau kx nzkabz badr mz nzwz-krdr. X trau kx nzyrlqo elr krlzle nzrkalz-ngrm. A' nzycmne-krde lc, trvzpxpuu mz nzyckr drtwrde leplz.
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Bzkq ycmnebzme bade. Da lc tqrtrngzti-ngrbzle ngi dalr nzoliqti-krbzle nrkrdrtqnge mz nzaelu-krbzlele tolo mzli kc nabz-ngrne.

Mnc-zvzamu badr leplz kcng trpnzngr scdr da, x krlzamu nzokatrngr nidr mzli kznikeng suti drtwrmu. A' ninge trnamnc-zvzpou bamu. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, takitrde nzaelwapx-krmamu nzmrlzti-zlwz-krmu ninge mzli ka.”
Kx nzxlr leplz nzmnckr Jiszs Betzni, sc tzvzpemqng. Trnzvz-ngrmlru Jiszs txpwz, a' nzrpilr namc-kzlr Lasarus kc tqatulz-mople.
Zbz kxnzetu rdr pris sc tzryrlqpeng drtwr kx nanibqpe-kz-ngrdr Lasarus.
Murde lr Jiu kxnzkqlung trnzvz-nqblqpelru kxnzetu rdrng, a' nzlxngitipelr Jiszs mz nzmc-krdr nzatulz-mou-krmle Lasarus.
Sade Kx Nzprlxlvztingr Nabx Nc Paam Mz Lrpzki R Jiszs Mz Nzvztr-krde Jerusalem
Nrlc kxngrlxobzle, nzxlr leplz kcng tzvzmqng mz Nzamyangr, kx Jiszs sc tqvzpe mz lrpzki mz nzvztr-krde Jerusalem. X sc tqvzpekr badr.

Zbz sc tzrlakipxpeng nabx nc paam, x sc tzrmcti-lzbqpeng badr mz nrlarde kx yz Jerusalem. X natqdr kc tqetupe tzrpipelr kx, “Hosana! Glqpxkr King Kxnzmcpx kc tqvzm mz drtq Yawe! Nim kc nangi King rgr lr Israel.”
Otim Jiszs kc nei dcngki, wxbuom elr x sc tqvope-ngrde. Da lc atutrle nzrpikr Profet kx, “Bzkq mwxlrpeamu lr Jerusalem! King rmu dese tqvzpem mz nrwx, votrp mz nei dcngki.”
Zbz mz nibr nzvzdzkr Jiszs Heven, sc tqdcpx ate mz drtwrgr kx da lcng tqprtzbz mz Jiszs nzatutrlr natq kcng tqyclz-pnz-kaip mz Nzryrngrkxtr, tzycmnetr-ngrdr Kxnzmcpx x nike naprtzbz bade.
A' mrkc Jerusalem leplz kx nzmclr Jiszs nzatulzpe-mou-krde Lasarus mz nzbzngr, sc tzlenepelr nrpa lc.
X kx nzxlr leplz kx nzkqlung rkx lcde, sc tzyrkr-ngrmlr mz Jiszs.
Zbz sc tzrpi-etrpe Farzsi kx, “Mzlengeng, tryatrpepwzkuu bade. Murde lr Jiu mz mztea amrlx nzvz-nqblqpelr nide.”
Jiszs Ycmnetr-ngrde Nzbz-krde
Kzdung lr Grik nzprtrpzng mz leplz kcng tzvzdzng Jerusalem mz nzakaputr-krmlr Nzamyangr.
Lr Grik lcng nzrpibzlr mz Filip kx, “Kxetu, rpikr naycmnekr badr Jiszs.”
Filip sc tqpipebzle mz kzdq lr mrnyzde, Adru. X sc tzvzmipebzlr lr Grik kcng mz Jiszs. Tzrpipebzlr kx, “Kxetu, leplz lcng trngiulrJiu nzrpilr naycmneamu badr.”
Mz nzayzlu-krbzle natqdr, Jiszs yapwxtipxbzle nzbz-krde kx na-arlapxle leplz kxnzkqlung. Rpibzle kx, “Ninge Mrlx Leplz. X mzli ka sc tqkrlzpebzle mzli r nzbz-krnge x nzvzdz-krnge Heven.

Naycmne-ebzpxbo nra wit. Murde nra wit nataole mz drtc' x namibiole mz nzryrlq-krbzle nrade kxkqlung. Nzmu trtaoleu mz drtc', esz'tx alo. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, na-apux nra wit mz nzbz-krnge murde na-arlapxx leplz kxnzkqlung.
Murde doa kx otr-zvzngr drtwrde nzlu-krde mz nrlc ka, sa namale-lvile nzlungr kxboi. A' doa kx yrlqtxole nzlu-krde mz nzvz-nqblq-krde ninge, sa naprtr mz nzlungr kxboi.
X mrlx kznike nawztrp bange navz-nqblqmle ninge, murde kxnzawz nengeng sa namnc-zvz-kzng mrkc namnc-ngrne. X Trtenge sa na-amatq leplz amrlx kcng tzwztrpqng bange.”

X mz nzaotikr drtwrde nzbz-krde lc, rpi-mople kx, “Mzli ka nabznge talvzo. ?Mrlz nzrlxti-krbo mz Trtenge kx bzkq rlrpx-ngrde nzbz-krnge? A' trtingr! Murde vz-nqblqle me pnz drtwrde. X vz-ngrmc mz nrlc murde na-angidatix da amrlx kcng naprtzmqng bange mz nzbz-krnge.
Trte, krka'-ngrne kx nzmyalz-krm na-aelwapxngr mz nzmnc-krnge. Eu, angida.” X mzli kcpwz Gct ycmneom Heven, rpile kx, “Nzmyalz-krnge aelwapxpe-ngrbo x sa na-ale-moux.”
Kx nzxlr leplz kcng natq Gct, kzdung nidr nzrpilr bzlrmei. A' kzdung nidr nzrpibzlr kx, “E trtingr, enjrl ne Gct ela tqycmnebz bade.”
A' rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Natq lc trngiu dalr nzokatr-krde ninge, a' ngi dalr nzokatr-krde nimu. Murde nakrlzamu kx Gct atwzlr-ngrmle ninge.
Mzli ka krlzmle mzli r nzpipxkr Gct kx lr nrlc nzvz-rbrng. X krlz-kzple mzli r nzaovxiokr Gct zmatq ngr Setzn, Kxetu r nrlc ka.
A' ninge Mrlx Leplz. X mzli kc naglqlz-ngrdr ninge, sa navectrpc' leplz amrlx bange.”
Mz natq lcng aelwapx-ngrde kx nabzom mz kros.
Rpibz leplz kcng bade kx, “?Nabzq? A' Lou scgu alvztr-ngrde nigu kx trpnzngr nzbzkr Kxnzmcpx. ?Nike tqrpi-ngrn mzli kc naglqlzngr Mrlx Leplz mz kros? ?Mrlx Leplz kznike?”

Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Apux zyzlr. A' sa namncbepo bamu mzli kxpipz. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, navz-nqblqamu nzalvztr-krngeng mzli ka tqmncbe-ngrbo bamu, murde ma tqtaoamu mz alwx kc tqakamrbr-ngrbzle da mz nabzmu. Murde doa kx vz-nqblqle da kx tropxu vz-rbr zvz.
Delc, mzli lc tqmncbe-ngrbo bamu, na-abrtrpa'mu drtwrmu bange, murde nanginimu doa nengeng mz nzale-krmu da kxtubq.”
Lr Jiu Vz Zvz Trnzlxngiti-krdru Jiszs
Yrkrpxbz nzycmne-krbz Jiszs, sc tqvzpekr badr mz nzmnc-kapq-krgr.
Murde trnzlxngitilru nzngini-krde Kxnzmcpx, kxmule-esz' rkx kcng kqlung tqalele, tzaelwapx-ngrdr zmatq ngr Gct.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, sc tqatutrpele natq Profet Asaea mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Yawe, trpnzngr kx lxngitile natqnge, x trpnzngr kx rkrlz zmatq kc tqaelwapx-ngrgr.”

X mz trnzrlxngiti-krdru lc, angidatipe-kzle natq Gct kc tqpipx Asaea, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Mztr nzakcpebz x nardr nzamqngipebz, murde nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzmc-krdr x nzlxngiti-krdr da angidr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, rblxbz badr nzyzlu-krmlr bange murde na-arlapxx nidr.”
Krlc tqkxmu nzryapwxkr Asaea lc, murde mcpe-kaile nzmyalzkr Kxnzmcpx mzli kc navz-ngrmle mz nrlc.

Yzuo mzli lc, kxnzetu r lr Jiu nzkqlung kx nzlxngitilr Jiszs. A' trnzpinedru murde nzmwxlrtilr Farzsi, ma tzyrlqtrpzlr nidr yz mz mangr-nzkrka'ngr x tzmapulrpx-ngrdr nidr mztea. Murde nzmrlzkr badr nzglqpxkr leplz nidr myaszpxle nzglqpxkr Gct nidr.
Nzayrplapxngr Vzpxm Mz Natq Jiszs
Jiszs natqde etutx mz nzrpi-krbzle mz zbo ngr leplz kcng kx, “Doa kx lxngitile ninge, trlxngitileu ninge esz'-krnge, a' lxngiti-kzle Gct kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle ninge.
X doa kx mcle ninge mcpe-kzle Gct.
Vzmc apux zyzlr kc tqaelwapx-ngrbzle mz lr nrlc kxnamu nzrlapx-krdr, murde doa kx lxngitile ninge trnataopeu mz alwx.
A' doa kx xlrle nzycmne-krnge x trlxngitileu, trna-ayrplapxwxu nide. Murde trvz-ngrpwc'u nzayrplapx-krnge lr nrlc, a' vzo-ngrmc Heven nzarlapx-krnge nidr.
A' nzayrplapxngr nidr vzpxm mz kxmu nzyrlq-krdr natqnge. Doa kx mapulrpx-ngrde ninge x pxtxpx-ngrde natqnge, vz-rbrpe x sa na-ayrplapx mz Mzli Kxmatq kc navzm.
Murde natq lcng tqpibo trnzvzpxpwqung bange, a' krlcng tqpibo natq kx nzvzpxmqng mz Trtenge. Natq lcng kamle bange kx napibo bamu.
X krlzx kx nzlungr kxboi vzpxm mz natq kx kamle. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, pix da kx pim Trtenge napibo bamu.”

footnotes.text: Traopxpwzu mz lr Jiu kx Nzryrngrkxtr rpile kx Kxnzmcpx na-aetqbz drtqde x naobqszo nide, na-atrkati nide, x nanibq nide. [Sam 22:1-18; 69:8, 11, 20-21; 118:22a; Asaea 53:1-12] Murde nzlxngitilr natq Gct kx rpile kx nangi king kc etu, na-aovxiole enqmi rdrng amrlx, x na-aclve-alole leplz amrlx. A' trnzlxngitilru natq kzbleng.
